Public API

  -H "Authorization: Bearer ps_live_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "integrationId": "int_123",
    "content": "Diwali sale is live",
    "publishAt": "2026-11-20T13:30:00.000Z"

Questions agencies ask us

Which platforms are supported?+

Facebook, Instagram, Threads, LinkedIn, YouTube, Pinterest, Google Business Profile and WhatsApp — 8 surfaces in one workspace.

Does anything go live without my approval?+

No. Posts, replies and ad change suggestions sit in an approval queue until you approve or edit them.

Can my clients log in?+

Yes. The client portal supports email + password or a magic link. Each client only sees their own channels, ads, leads and reports.

Is my clients' data separate?+

Yes. Every query is scoped per client and organisation. Team members can be limited to assigned clients.

Do you support WhatsApp broadcasts? What does it cost?+

Yes — templates, broadcasts with a per-message cost estimate, and keyword auto-replies. Meta template messages are billed separately at Meta’s rate (we show an estimate around ₹0.80/msg in the product).

Can I use my own domain and brand?+

Agency plans support white-label portal title, brand colour and a custom domain for the client portal.

Do you have an API?+

Yes on Agency Pro: posts, analytics, leads and WhatsApp send under /api/v1 with per-key permissions and IP allowlists.

Which AI do you use?+

Claude by Anthropic powers captions, triage, lead scores and report narratives. Usage is tracked per client.

Do you give GST invoices?+

Yes. Razorpay checkout in INR with GST invoices (CGST/SGST or IGST split) for Indian agencies.

How do I get support?+

WhatsApp (+91 91191 05802) or support@podospheretechnologies.com. Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 7 pm IST.
